description: Reflection® for the Web provides terminal emulation from a web browser. With this server-based solution you can connect local or remote users to applications on IBM, HP, UNIX, and OpenVMS hosts. You can also use its comprehensive management, security, and customization features to boost IT efficiency and user productivity.
